simple.meaning: רְעָבוֹן (rᵉʻâbôwn) is a Hebrew object word meaning “famine.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 42:19. The surrounding context includes family, family line, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רְעָבוֹן (H7459) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: רְעָבוֹן (rᵉʻâbôwn) / H7459 is traced through Genesis 42:19, Genesis 42:33, Psalms 37:19 with generated occurrence evidence.
